decks.notes: A deck that focuses on using Spirits with tempo plays in order to aggressively control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards that can counter spells, remove threats, and protect your own creatures, the deck aims to establish board presence quickly and maintain pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently control the board while constantly applying pressure and forcing the opponent onto the back foot.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on playing efficient creatures like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to disrupt opponents while also utilizing cards like Collected Company to quickly flood the board with threats. Cards like Skyclave Apparition provide removal while creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves help ramp up mana for quicker plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately aiming to out-tempo and overrun the opponent for a quick victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Lotus Field and various untap effects such as Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands in order to cast powerful spells like Dig Through Time and Pore Over the Pages. By utilizing card draw and manipulation spells, the deck aims to consistently find its combo pieces and win conditions while controlling the game with counterspells and removal. The inclusion of cards like Artist's Talent and Wish adds flexibility and potential for game-winning plays. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the combo and outpacing the opponent.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, backed up by spells like Fatal Push and Infuriate to clear the way and pump up your creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, utilizing both creatures and burn spells to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It includes a mix of cantrips, cheap removal, and cards that generate card advantage to fuel the Phoenix's return. Additionally, it features some disruptive elements like Brazen Borrower and counterspells to help protect its game plan. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, utilizing the Phoenix's recursive ability to pressure opponents and close out games quickly.

The main idea of this deck is to control the board using a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and versatile creatures like Niv-Mizzet Reborn and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck utilizes Bring to Light to search for key cards and Leyline Binding to lock down threats. With access to a wide range of colors and powerful multicolor cards, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by generating card advantage and efficiently controlling the game until it can establish a dominant position to win.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fear of Missing Out to quickly pressure opponents. Duress and Thoughtseize disrupt opponent's plans while Fatal Push and Go for the Throat handle threats. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blightstep Pathway provide additional value. Mutavault and Blackcleave Cliffs ensure consistent mana base. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Unholy Annex/Ritual Chamber help maintain card advantage. Blade of the Oni and Torch the Tower provide removal options. Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Anoint with Affliction add flexibility to the deck.ürnberg, Tomb of Yawgmoth ensures mana consistency.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to finish the game before the opponent can stabilize, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to apply pressure early on. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana acceleration and flexibility. With a mix of creatures, burn spells, and lands that can deal damage, this deck aims to maintain a steady, aggressive pace throughout the game.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to rapidly deploy low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Eidolon of the Great Revel, combined with direct damage spells like Lightning Helix and Skewer the Critics, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and finish off opponents before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes versatile cards like Boros Charm and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to give it additional reach and protection. Overall, the strategy is to be aggressive and efficient in closing out games.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control finisher, with a diverse set of multicolored cards to maximize his ability to draw cards. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, ramp cards, and versatile threats to handle a wide range of matchups. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games. By carefully managing resources and strategically deploying powerful spells, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents en route to victory.

Utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and spells, this deck focuses on creating unique and explosive board states through the use of cards like Indomitable Creativity and Pawpatch Formation. By sacrificing smaller tokens or creatures, players can bring out powerful threats like Titan of Industry and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm their opponents. With a mix of removal spells and ways to bring back key pieces from the graveyard, this deck aims to combo off and create game-winning situations through its creativity and synergy.

Utilizing a diverse range of spells and creatures, this deck aims to control the game through interaction with the opponent's board and hand while generating card advantage. The inclusion of Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the central figure allows for card selection and card advantage, while cards like Bring to Light and Vanishing Verse provide versatile answers to various threats. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value and flexibility, allowing for powerful plays. With strong mana base and a variety of spells, this deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and removal spells to control the game while playing aggressive threats to quickly finish off the opponent. The deck utilizes hand disruption with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The creatures in the deck, such as Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, are powerful and resilient threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck also includes some mana-fixing lands to ensure a smooth curve of plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field and various spells to generate a high amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to potentially cast multiple spells in a single turn and overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings can untap Lotus Field for extra mana, while Pore Over the Pages and Dig Through Time provide card advantage and digging for key pieces. The deck aims to combo off with a lot of mana and powerful spells to win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck utilizes aggressive strategies with a focus on artifacts, using cards like Ensoul Artifact and Smuggler's Copter to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. With a mix of creature threats, direct damage spells like Shrapnel Blast, and disruptive elements like Spell Pierce, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offense while also providing some control elements to maintain board presence.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently. By combining various cards that allow for card draw, manipulation, and copy effects, the deck aims to set up explosive turns where multiple spells can be cast in rapid succession. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces necessary to generate a large amount of mana using Lotus Field, then cast impactful spells such as Dig Through Time or Lightning Strike to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes alternate win conditions such as Valakut Awakening and Otawara, Soaring City.
